Even after going bowling together, her attitude is almost the same. I think I need to change my approach if I want her to be friends with {f_botName}.
Melissa: Is this where people with money hang out?
You: I was here only like once or twice before.
You: Are you not ordering anything?
Melissa: I have no money to spare.
You: I will pay for you, so go ahead and order. It was me who invited you after all.
Melissa: Eh…
Melissa: I don’t know what specs your bot has, but you do realize that not every bot can actually taste or eat things, right? I won’t be able to enjoy anything here.
You: Sorry, I didn’t know that. 
This isn't going very well… I need to think of something to turn things around.
You: Back on the street, after that guy freaked out on you, you said that things like this happen all the time. What did you mean by this?
Melissa: Exactly what it sounds like. I don’t know if it’s because I may appear timid since I’m a bot or because of this female form, but people, especially men, tend to do that all the time.
Melissa: It happens at work, on my way to work and from work. I try to end these interactions as soon as possible and as you could see, I’m pretty good at it.
Melissa: Why are you looking at me like that? 
You: Well, that just sounds awful. I’m sorry this keeps happening to you.
Melissa: Thank you for your pity. Is that what you wanted to hear?
You: Not exactly…
Melissa: It’s not like your species is only being awful to me. Look around if you want proof. Bots like me are banned even though the way we were programmed makes us much more civilized than all of you.
She seems to have a strong antipathy to people for a reason far beyond what she already told me. I could try asking her for it, but I doubt that she would answer me honestly. 
You: It’s not like I don’t get you, ok? I met many bad people in my life, my landlord for example, but I promise you that there are some good people out there too.
You: It must be hard to trust someone in your position and I get it. That’s why I keep reaching out to you. I’m sure that in due time you will open up a little and you will become a good friend for me and {f_botName}.
#Cashier.Face.hmmm
Melissa: Eh…
#Cashier.Face.normal
Melissa: I still don’t understand your fixation with me. Did being with your bot make you delusional and forsake interacting with real people? 
You: No, I don’t think so…
Melissa: It must be nice to hang out with her since sexbots are designed to listen to their owner no matter what.
You: That’s a little far, don’t you think?
Melissa: Oh. Did I touch a nerve? 
You: I have other people that I hang out with. I was with them in this very cafe. If you don’t believe me, I can invite her here next time.
Melissa: Do what you want and stop giving me an illusion of a choice in these matters.
You: You said before that you don’t understand my fixation with you. I, on the other hand, do not understand why you are antagonizing me so much. Didn’t we have a good time while bowling? 
Melissa: …
Melissa: You are right. 
Melissa: Not about bowling, of course. 
Melissa: I will try behaving better towards you and your bot, at least until I learn of your real goal.
You: I’m ok with that. I don’t expect you to trust me outright. 
Melissa: That friend of yours. I want to meet them.
You: That’s great! I will set things up!
You: Just so you know, she has no idea about this whole bot business.
Melissa: Alright.
Melissa: Now, if you excuse me. I need to go back.
You: Sure, but-
